Title: Aditya's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Aditya - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Anita - 39 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "Aditya, what's the plan today?"

[Aditya runs to Mother.]

Anita: "Well done!"

[Aditya shouts angrily.]

Aditya: "Really?"

[Aditya lights a diya.]

Anita: "And then?"

Scene 2: The bedroom - Day

[Aditya is asleep in bed in the bedroom. Anita stands near him.]

Aditya: "What a nice place."

[Aditya wakes up and rubs his eyes.]

Aditya: "What next?"

Scene 3: The park - Day

Aditya: "What a nice place."

[Aditya throws the ball to Mother.]

Aditya: "That's easy."

[Aditya kicks the football hard.]

Aditya: "What next?"

[Aditya plays cricket in the park.]

Aditya (excited): "Show me too!"

[Aditya swings on the swing.]

Aditya: "Hey, look at that!"

[Aditya goes down the slide.]

Aditya: "And then?"

[Aditya plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Aditya (softly): "What a day to remember!"
